slides.title: What does it cost in total?
slides.body: Add up a year of licenses, add-ons, admin time and consultant hours. That's the number to compare.

slides.title: Who needs a full seat?
slides.body: Count the people who only look records up, and note what each one needs to see.

slides.title: Which customizations still matter?
slides.body: List the custom objects, Flows and Apex. Mark what people use and what nobody would miss.

slides.title: Do the reports agree?
slides.body: Pick the numbers leadership checks most. Find out whether two reports ever give different answers.

slides.title: What connects to it?
slides.body: List every integration, such as email, calendar, accounting, forms and payments. Each one has to move or be rebuilt.

slides.title: When does the contract renew?
slides.body: Note the renewal date and the notice period. Any move should land before the contract rolls over.
